name: race_offline_outcome_cap_draw
description: A race drawn at the 20-minute cap says that rule (design 1.3: at the cap more waves cleared, then more lives, then the lower race time, else a draw; review of M6's race views: every draw read 'Two crews, one time', the title again, though neither crew set a time). Over the session's offline race, a Tide Race of two seats waits out long windows with five waves cleared on each hollow and every life kept. At the cap the simulation calls it a draw for both teams, and the results say 'Two Crews, One Time' with the rule 'Twenty minutes: as many waves cleared and lives kept'.

steps.assert: Game.sim.tick == int(Game.sim.rules['cap_t']) and Game.sim.cleared_waves(0) == 5 and Game.sim.cleared_waves(1) == 5 and Game.sim.teams[0].lives == Game.sim.teams[1].lives
steps.msg: twenty minutes of match time, five waves cleared on each hollow and as many lives
neither crew set a race time
the cap calls it a draw for both teams

steps.assert: node('ResultsTitle').text == 'TWO CREWS, ONE TIME' and node('ResultsRule').text == 'Twenty minutes: as many waves cleared and lives kept'
steps.msg: the results name the rule that tied, not the title again
